decision.nextRecommendedStep: Independently seeded end-to-end training replicas of the unchanged expert-v2 recipe and checkpoint-selection rule, under a separately frozen bounded protocol with fresh nonreserved roots. Report all replicas and between-training variability instead of selecting the best on these stress outcomes. Do not immediately tune on sparse stress subgroups or Italy/Benelux.
decision.interpretationReview: Separate read-only review agrees that the frozen gate passes and favors unchanged-recipe training replication over immediate targeted tuning. The main remaining uncertainties are training-seed variability, subgroup robustness and generalization beyond fixed populations, not the audited artifact integrity.
decision.rationale: The frozen candidate outperforms predeclared PPO2 on both fixed stress panels and has positive point differences on all eight panel/map aggregates. This supports testing training-seed robustness, not universal superiority or qualification.

The strong non-Germany expert24 score is exactly 1/n within each all-seat cluster (.29 macro), an integrity identity rather than independent strength evidence.
Secondary cell/map-by-player results include negative point estimates; the predeclared gate concerns only both primaries and map aggregates.

Across 40 map/player/panel means, 37 are positive, two zero and one negative: mixed USA at three players, -0.10416666666666666 with exploratory 95% interval [-0.2852507222463482, 0.07691738891301486]. Its fast-auction cells are diagnostic watchpoints, not proof of a reproducible failure or a new stopping rule.

Recharged fast auctions are the weakest rule aggregate in both panels, although all rule aggregates remain positive. All four negative mixed full cells use fast auctions. USA strong at two and five players has zero observed mean difference, not established equivalence.
Expert-v2 and PPO2 also differ in fixed phase mechanics/prior and training recipe; this is a bundled policy comparison, not a causal component ablation.
Italy/Benelux were not stress-tested; no human-strength, promotion, deployment or reserved-final-seed claim.
